_doc: Exact Wikimedia Commons file titles, chosen by looking at the picture.
A pin always beats the automatic search. Scoring a title gets you most of
the way and then fails in ways no rule can catch: Denver's automatic pick
was a satellite terrain render titled 'Denver Skyline (4801).jpg', and
Amsterdam's was parked cars under a bare tree. Both scored well. Both were
wrong. The only reliable fix is a human looking.
A pin does NOT override the licence gate. Liking a photo is not permission
to publish it, so a pinned file whose licence fails still gets rejected and
the city falls back to the automatic search.
To change one: run scripts/photo_candidates.py <CODE>, look at the sheet in
out/photo-candidates/<CODE>.png, and copy the title of the tile you want
